name: Turvagal
title: Pastador das Margens
ecologicalNiche: heavy riverine grazer and shallow-water vegetation controller
artDirection: Barrel-like green-brown quadruped, short strong limbs, broad dark snout, low overlapping dorsal scales, split hooves and heavy tufted tail.
behavior: Wades, feeds around reedbeds, enters shallow water to avoid threats.
notes: Original Wildhaven creature designed from approved concept direction. GLB animated by hierarchical rigid pivots; visual review pending, not integrated in game.
